_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Thursday — infrastructure and observability hardening day. (1) CoreWeave and Meta formalise $21B AI-infrastructure expansion (reporting surfaced Wed); total contracted backlog with Meta ~$35B through Dec 2032; first deployments of NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform. Nine of top ten AI model providers run on CoreWeave — 'neocloud' lands in market commentary same day. (2) Cisco announces intent to acquire Galileo Technologies — full AI-agent observability platform; two-day pivot from Glasswing partner (Apr 7) to observability M&A; Splunk Observability Cloud's AI Agent Monitoring integrates Galileo's single instrumentation layer (prompt optimisation + model selection + evaluation + production monitoring + real-time guardrails for multi-agent systems). 'Glasswing access → observability tooling → enterprise control plane' pattern becomes explicit M&A play, not just analyst speculation. (3) Bessent (Treasury) and Powell (Fed) confirmed to convene Wall Street CEOs (Fraser, Pick, Moynihan, Scharf, Solomon) on Tuesday Apr 14 — first time post-Glasswing federal financial regulators are organising banks at CEO level around a specific named frontier model; sets up Bank of England equivalent Apr 11 and ECB follow-on mid-month. Reported Fortune Apr 10 under embargo; surfaces Apr 9. (4) OpenAI Agents SDK ships v1.0 with broader cross-vendor compatibility — specifically integrating Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 + Azure AI Foundry runtime. Agents SDK becoming explicitly Azure-native accelerates broader Microsoft / OpenAI alignment ahead of Apr 27 next-phase partnership announcement. (5) Snowflake AI Pulse pre-brief — Cortex Code now in active use by 50%+ of Snowflake customers; Snowflake Intelligence positioned as 'personal work agent'; deep research with multi-step citation reports going public-preview soon — first hard metric for enterprise data-platform vendors moving from 'AI feature' to 'AI control plane'. Plus: NVIDIA National Robotics Week coverage starts + LangGraph v0.4 HITL checkpoints + LangChain State of Agent Engineering 57% in production / +30.4% with concrete deployment plans + Holland & Knight EU AI Act Aug-2026 deadline alert + IAPP machinery-rules amendments. Research: RAGEN-2 'template collapse' in agentic RL (outputs structurally similar across inputs while entropy looks healthy — explains why agent RL plateaus when standard metrics don't predict it) — sharpest diagnostic of the week; MARS multi-token AR generation; Neural Computers (position paper — models as runtime systems learning from I/O traces); Combee parallel prompt-learning; SEVerA Formally Guarded Generative Models + Dafny verification; Personalized RewardBench; Qualixar OS MCP+A2A+UCP runtime; AgentGL LLM agents subsume GNNs; Depth Ceiling (LLMs execute latent reasoning at varying depths but consistently fail to discover right multi-step planning strategies — discovery and execution dissociate). STAGE MOVES: wall-street-mythos-briefings (new) → emerging. autonomous-cyber-capability fast EMA elevated as Bessent/Powell reporting compounds. agentic-observability-stack fast EMA surges on Cisco-Galileo + LangGraph v0.4 + LangChain SoAE.
